source: 723 Secret of Immortality
target: 723 Secretum Immortalitatis

source: After some time had passed, Anthony Reid guided the shriveled brownish-yellow dog back to the quarry cave that housed a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
target: Post aliquod tempus transactum, Anthony Reid canem exsiccatum flavobrunnum ad speluncam lapideam, quae ostium stabile ad mundum specularum continebat, duxit.

source: Turning to Lumian, he said, “You can dispel the Animal Creation Spell now.”
target: Ad Lumianum conversus, dixit: “Iam potes incantationem creationis animalis expellere.”

source: Lumian glanced at the enormous dog, which had lost its ferocious and ruthless demeanor.
target: Lumian intuitus est in magnum canem, qui mores feroces et implacabiles amisit.

source: With a smile, he recited the dispelling incantation in Hermes: “Monk!”
target: Cum risu, incantationem expellendi in lingua Hermetica recitavit: “Monk!”

source: Lumian had personally crafted the ritualistic dog skin.
target: Lumian ipse pelle canina rituali confecit.

source: While he had used Padre Guillaume Bénet’s activation incantation, he had modified the dispelling incantation.
target: Cum incantationem activationis a Patre Guillaume Bénet usus esset, incantationem expellendi mutaverat.

source: Initially, Lumian wanted to use the name of Gehrman Sparrow, one of his two idols, as the dispelling incantation.
target: Initio, Lumian voluit nomine Gehrman Sparrow, uno ex duobus idolis suis, uti incantatione expellendi.

source: However, since Gehrman was Mr. Fool’s Angel of Redemption, uttering his name in Hermes might have unusual consequences and seem blasphemous.
target: Tamen, cum Gehrman esset Angelus Redemptionis Domini Stulti, eius nomen in lingua Hermetica pronuntiare fortasse consequentias insolitas haberet atque blasphemia appareret.

source: Consequently, Lumian discarded that idea.
target: Itaque, Lumian illam ideam abiecit.

source: Since the first ritualistic hide he made was dog skin, Lumian drew inspiration from the phrase “Monks Chasing Dogs” and chose the word “Monk” for the dispelling incantation.
target: Cum prima pellis ritualis quam fecisset esset pelle canina, Lumian inspirationem traxit ex dictione “Monachi Canes Persecutores” et verbum “Monk” tamquam incantationem expellendi elegit.

source: As a dark light flared, it revealed a pitiful-looking Moran Avigny.
target: Cum lux obscura micavit, revelavit speciem miserabilem Moran Avigny.

source: Instinctively, Moran reached for a handkerchief in his chest pocket and wiped away the dried blood, tears, saliva, and mucus from his face.
target: Instinctu impulsus, Moran sudarium in sinu suo arripuit et ex facie sua sanguinem siccatum, lacrimas, salivam, atque mucum abstergit.

source: Rather than getting directly to the point, Lumian decided to begin with trivial questions to bolster his credibility and optimize the hypnotic effect.
target: Potius quam directe ad rem pervenire, Lumian decrevit quaestiones leues incipere, ut auctoritatem suam corroboraret et vim hypnoticam optimaret.

source: With a blend of derision and a sigh, he said, “I can’t grasp why you Mirror People loathe your real world equivalents.”
target: Cum mixtione derisionis et suspirio, dixit: “Nescio cur vos, homines specularum, veros mundi aequales oderitis.”

source: Moran Avigny sneered in response.
target: Moran Avigny in responsum deridens irrise respondit.

source: “If you were perpetually confined to the cold, gloomy, sealed mirror, you’d also despise your counterpart who basks in the sun, savors fine food and drink, and revels in leisure and pleasure.”
target: “Si perpetuo in speculo frigido, tristi, et clauso recluderetur, etiam oderetis alterum vestrum, qui in sole nititur, cibum et potum exquisitum degustat, atque in otio et voluptate delectatur.”

source: “But your existence wasn’t a natural occurrence. It was an accident,” Jenna pointed out, narrowly avoiding mentioning that they were monstrosities inhabiting a unique mirror world.
target: “Sed vestra existentia non fuit naturalis ortus; casus erat,” inquit Jenna, vix referens eos monstros in mundo speculari unico habitantes.

source: Chuckling, Moran Avigny retorted, “What bearing does that have on our envy and hatred?”
target: Subridens, Moran Avigny derisit: “Quid ad nostram invidiam et odium pertinet?”

source: “We didn’t trigger the accident. As we were born and have been perpetuating our kind, we possess the right to seek a superior life.”
target: “Accidentem non excitavimus. Cum nati simus et genus nostrum perpetuo propagaverimus, ius habemus vitam superiorem quaerere.”

source: Momentarily at a loss for words, Franca and Jenna fell silent.
target: Paululum verbis carentes, Franca et Jenna silentium ceperunt.

source: Speaking in a friendly tone, Lumian said, “You indeed have that right. However, it cannot involve murder or injuring the original body. Why not collaborate with official organizations, such as the Church of The Fool? After fleeing Fourth Epoch Trier, you could depart this city and commence a new life elsewhere.”
target: Dulciter loquens, Lumian dixit: “Ius hoc vestrum vere tenetis. Attamen id non potest implicare homicidium vel laesionem corporis originarii. Cur non collaboratis cum societatibus officialibus, ut Ecclesia Stulti? Postquam a Trier Epochae Quartae effugistis, hanc urbem relinquere atque vitam novam alibi incipere potestis.”

source: Moran Avigny scoffed.
target: Moran Avigny derisit.

source: “You believe we can trust and cooperate with these sun-dwelling organizations?”
target: “Credisne nos posse confidere atque cooperari cum his organisationibus, quae in sole degunt?”

source: “Are you not already collaborating with the School of Truth?” Lumian exposed Moran Avigny’s deception.
target: “Nonne iam cum Schola Veritatis collaboratis?” inquit Lumian, fraudem Moran Avigny detegens.

source: After a brief pause, Moran Avigny stated, “We have a mission. We desire the authentic restoration of this world.”
target: Post brevem moram, Moran Avigny dixit: “Missionem habemus. Veram restitutionem huius mundi desideramus.”

source: “Authentic?” Lumian intentionally provoked. “How can authenticity exist in a mirror? You Mirror People merely resemble the genuine ones. Upon death, you will revert to mirror shards.”
target: “Authenticum?” provocavit Lumian; “Quomodo authenticitas in speculo existere potest? Vos, homines specularum, tantum genuinos simillimini. Post mortem, in frusta speculi redibitis.”

source: Following the provocation, Lumian’s eyes turned silver-black as he examined Moran Avigny’s fate tributary, aiming to deter him from providing a response that could endanger his life.
target: Post provocationem, oculi Lumiani in argenteo nigro versa sunt, dum fata Moran Avigny explorabat, intentus eum deterrere ne responsum praebeat quod vitam eius in discrimen adduceret.

source: After a quick observation confirming that his question wouldn’t pose a significant risk, Lumian deactivated the Eye of Calamity to preserve his spirituality.
target: Postquam celeriter observaverit quaestionem suam minorem periculum non afferre, Lumian Oculum Calamitatis deactivavit ad spiritualitatem suam conservandam.

source: With a meaningful smile, Moran Avigny said, “No, in a certain sense, what resides in the mirror is real.
target: Cum risu significativo, Moran Avigny dixit: “Non, quadā ratione, quod in speculo habitat, verum est.

source: “Upon completing our mission, we will fully return to reality!”
target: “Missionem peracta, penitus ad realitatem revertamur!”

source: Intrigued by Moran Avigny’s confidence, Franca asked, “Why do you say that?”
target: Intrigata fiducia Moran Avigny, Franca quaesivit: “Cur id dicis?”

source: Moran Avigny’s gaze swept over the two Demonesses.
target: Oculi Moran Avigny super duas daemonissas migraverunt.

source: Now in his refractory period, he chuckled and said, “Even I cannot comprehend the most basic reason. All I can disclose is that it relates to the Chaos Demoness we revere deep within the mirror world. She is the true Primordial Demoness!”
target: Iam in suo tempore refractory, subridens dixit: “Etiam ego rationem simplicissimam comprehendere non possum. Tantum possum dicere quod refert ad Daemonissam Chaoticam, quam intime in mundo specularum colimus; ea est vera Daemonissa Primordialis!”

source: “Moreover, I can offer an example: After transforming into a Witch and interacting with mirror magic, every Demoness’s true self dwells within the mirror.”
target: Praeterea, exemplum proferre possum: postquam in magam conversus et cum magia speculari operatus, veram ipsam cuiusque daemonissae in speculo habitat.

source: Observing Franca and Jenna’s skepticism, Moran Avigny, eager to express his thoughts, inquired with a smile,
target: Observantes Franca et Jennae scepticismum, Moran Avigny, cogitationes suas exprimere cupiens, subridens interrogavit:

source: “Are you aware of the Demoness pathway’s Sequence 3 name?”
target: “Scitisne nomen Sequentiae Tertiae viæ daemonissae?”

source: In unison, Franca and Jenna shook their heads. “No.”
target: Simul, Franca et Jenna capita neglexerunt, dicentes: “Non.”

source: With a slight nod, Moran Avigny explained, “It’s known as the Demoness of Unaging. Eternal youth, skilled in resurrection and rebirth.”
target: Levis annuens, Moran Avigny explanavit: “Notum est ut Daemonissa Sine Senectute. Iuventus aeterna, perita in resurrectione atque renascentia.”

source: “Why are they so challenging to kill, capable of resurrection and rebirth? It’s because what they destroy is merely their external form. Their authentic selves have always been imprisoned and sealed within the mirror!”
target: “Cur sunt tam difficiles ad interficiendos, et quare facultatem resurrectionis et renascentiae habent? Nam quod deleant, sola forma externa eorum est; vera ipsa semper in speculo reclusae atque sigillatae fuerunt!”

source: “If the false ones perish, they can swiftly be resurrected through the projection of their true selves in the mirror!”
target: “Si falsi periant, celeriter resurrecti esse possunt per proiectionem verarum suarum in speculo!”

source: “Consider this: how can one’s true self, imprisoned, sealed, and utilized as a source of resurrection, not despise the false one in reality? Why wouldn’t they yearn to escape the mirror and reclaim what is rightfully theirs?”
target: “Considera hoc: quomodo quis suam veram, inclusam et sigillatam atque uti fonte resurrectionis, false in re oderit? Cur non desiderarent ex speculo evadere atque recuperare id quod iure ipsorum est?”

source: Franca abruptly recalled the moment she first entered the unique mirror world.
target: Franca subito meminit momenti quo primum in singularem mundum specularum ingressa est.

source: At that time, she had encountered her body’s original self, the one with thick brown eyebrows and short flaxen-colored hair before ingesting the Witch potion.
target: Eo tempore, occurrit formae originali corporis sui, quae crassis superciliis fusco-brunneis et brevibus capillis flavis praedita erat, antequam potionem magae ingereret.

source: His face was drenched in blood, and his eyes brimmed with malice and hatred.
target: Facies eius sanguine imbutus erat, et oculi eius malitia et odio repleti erant.

source: Could it be that after drinking the Witch potion and transforming into a woman, her male self didn’t disappear but was exiled to the mirror, unable to escape? Franca was both alarmed and suspicious.
target: Numquid ita est ut, post potionem magae bibendo et in feminam conversam, eius masculinum se non evanuerit sed in speculum exsilium relegatum sit, ne effugere possit? Franca simul perturbata atque suspicata erat.

source: Jenna also remembered something from her past.
target: Jenna etiam aliquid ex praeterito suo meminit.

source: During the process of becoming a Witch, she saw her other self in an illusion—her malevolent, mirror-like self.
target: Per processum quo magam fiebat, in illusionem alteram se vidit—eam malevolam, speculo similem ipsam.

source: Both of them plummeted into the black flames, and she struggled to crawl out, returning to the ice above the black flames to complete her advancement.
target: Utraque in flammas nigras ruperunt, et illa conata est evadere, reptando rediens ad glaciem super flammas nigras ut progressionem suam compleret.

source: The malevolent self was dragged into the bottomless Abyss by the python-like black shadow.
target: Ea natura malevola in abyssum sine fundo traxit umbra nigra, simili pythona.

source: Could it symbolize self-division?
target: Num hoc divisionem sui ipsius significat?

source: Is a part of me truly suffering in the mirror?
target: Num pars mei vere in speculo patitur?

source: Noticing his two Demoness companions’ perplexed state, Lumian smiled at Moran Avigny and said, “It doesn’t necessarily involve self-imprisonment. It’s conceivable that during the Witch transformation process, they formed a profound connection with their mirror selves, enabling them to master mirror magic. To a degree, this also allows for their resurrection.”
target: Animadvertere de statu perplexo duarum daemonissarum sociarum, Lumian subridens ad Moran Avigny intulit et dixit: “Hoc necessario non ad ipsos incarcerationem pertinet. Possibile est ut, per processum transformationis magae, relationem profundam cum suis specularibus formis coniuncti sint, quo magiam speculari dominari possint; quatenus hoc etiam resurrectioni eorum favet.”

source: “The mirror self is tainted with blood, malice, hatred, and malevolence because they are perpetually in this state. They constantly envy their real selves, just like you Mirror People from a unique world.”
target: “Specularis imago sanguine, malitia, odio atque malevolentia polluta est, quoniam in hoc statu perpetuo manent; semper vero veris ipsis oderunt, sicut vos, homines specularum ex mundo unico.”

source: Unable to uncover the truth at the moment, Lumian preferred not to linger on the subject and attempted to shift the blame to others.
target: Ne veritatem detegere posset, Lumian maluit in hac re non diutius manere atque culpam in alios transferre conari.

source: Furthermore, as a Mirror Person, Moran Avigny had an innate inclination to take sides. His words needed to be cautiously accepted and analyzed from a different perspective.
target: Praeterea, ut homo specularis, Moran Avigny naturale habebat inclinat ad partes assumendas; verba eius caute accipienda et ex altera perspectiva perpendenda erant.

source: Upon hearing Lumian’s explanation, Franca and Jenna’s expressions softened.
target: Audita explanatio Lumiani, vultus Francae et Jennae leniti sunt.

source: Moran Avigny mocked, “Self-deception cannot conceal the truth.”
target: Moran Avigny derisit: “Autocellatio veritatem celare non potest.”

source: Recognizing that the initial preparations were nearly complete, Lumian decided to redirect the conversation back to the main topic.
target: Ratus praeparationes inititiales paene completas esse, Lumian decrevit sermonem ad rem principalem redire.

source: Originally, their objective was related to Mirror People, but now Lumian sensed that the matter involving the School of Truth was more relevant and pressing. He needed to inquire about it first.
target: Primum, propositum eorum ad homines speculares pertinebat, sed nunc Lumian sensit rem, quae ad Scholae Veritatis pertinebat, propius et urgentius esse; de ea re primum rogare oportuit.

source: His eyes turned silver-black once more as he gazed at Moran Avigny and asked, “Did you enter into a contract with the School of Truth’s Overseer?”
target: Oculi eius iterum in argenteo nigro versa sunt, dum in Moran Avigny intuebatur atque rogavit: “Contractum cum Praefecto Scholae Veritatis contraxistine?”

source: “Of course we did. How else could we collaborate? We all value contracts,” Moran Avigny replied with pride.
target: “Certe fecerimus. Quo alio modo cooperari possemus? Omnes contractus aestimamus,” respondit Moran Avigny cum superbia.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “He didn’t surreptitiously modify the terms the instant you signed the contract, did he?”
target: “Nonne, statim postquam contractum signer, condiciones non occulte mutavit?”

source: “No, I am highly attentive to such matters. As you know, I am a Judge in the mystical sense,” Moran Avigny responded confidently.
target: “Non, tali rebus valde attendam. Ut scis, iudex sum ad modum mysticum,” respondit Moran Avigny confidente.

source: Lumian probed further, “Have you met the Overseer?”
target: Lumian ulterius quaesivit: “Num Praefectum convenisti?”

source: Moran Avigny shook his head.
target: Moran Avigny caput neglexerit.

source: “He signed the contract first and then dispatched his subordinate to deliver it. We never actually met.”
target: “Primum ipsi contractum signer, deinde subordinate suo illud tradidit. Nos autem vere numquam convenimus.”

source: “What has the Overseer been up to lately?” Lumian inquired cautiously.
target: “Quid nuper Praefectus egit?” quaesivit Lumian caute.

source: Moran Avigny chuckled.
target: Moran Avigny subridens risit.

source: “I am merely a cog of his immense Under the Table black net. I assist in completing specific matters through transactions. I am unaware of what those matters allude to or the motivations behind them.”
target: “Ego tantum sum rota in ingenti reticulo nigro sub mensa eius. Ad complenda quaedam negotia per transactiones ago. Nescio quid illa negotia referant aut quae sint eorum causae.”

source: “Yes, he once mentioned that he intended to use individuals like me to weave an invisible and massive vortex. He could infuse his strongest desires into it and achieve results.
target: “Ita, aliquando dixit se velle uti hominibus sicut me ad texendum vortex invisibilis et ingentis. Potuit in eo desideria sua vehementissima infundere ac effectus adipisci.”

source: “A few days ago, he casually remarked that the vortex is on the verge of taking shape.”
target: “Aliquot diebus abhinc, leniter inquit vortex formam capere imminere.”

source: The vortex is about to take shape… Lumian continued to monitor the changes in Moran Avigny’s fate tributary and, after some contemplation, asked, “How do you and the Overseer typically communicate? Is there a special contingency plan in case of an emergency?”
target: “Vortex mox formare se incipit… Lumian mutationes in fata Moran Avigny perspexit, et post aliquam cogitationem rogavit: ‘Quomodo vos et Praefecto solitum communicatis? Estne consilium speciale pro casu necessitatis?’”

source: This was something he needed to ascertain as quickly as possible. The abrupt attack on Intis’s Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, and his enigmatic disappearance was breaking news. It wouldn’t take long for the news to spread. When that happened, the Overseer would undoubtedly learn about it and promptly sever his original communication channel.
target: Hoc erat aliquid quod celeriter determinare debebat. Impetus abruptus in Ministrum Industriae Intis, Moran Avigny, atque eius enigmata evanatione novas edebat nuntios. Non multum tempore requireret ut nuntii disseminarent. Quum id factum esset, Praefectus certo id cognosceret atque statim canalem communicationis originalis disjungeret.

source: In Moran Avigny’s villa.
target: In villa Moran Avigny.

source: Angoulême de François, the captain of the Purifier mobile team directly under Trier’s diocese, had been prepared and swiftly arrived at the scene.
target: Angoulême de François, capitaneus turmae mobilis Purificatorum directe sub dioecesi Trieri, paratus fuit et celeriter ad locum pervenit.

source: After listening to the on‐scene Purifiers’ report and assessing the scene, Angoulême frowned.
target: Postquam relationem Purificatorum in situ audivit atque locum percontatus est, Angoulême frontem contraxit.

source: “A member of the Aurora Order?”
target: “Membrum Ordinis Aurorae?”

source: Not Hidden Blade and the others?
target: Non Culter Occultus et ceteri?

source: What are they up to!
target: Quid agunt!

source: Following a moment of reflection, Angoulême issued an order,
target: Post momentum meditationis, Angoulême iussum edidit:

source: “Let’s first suppress the news of Moran Avigny’s incident to avoid alerting the individuals and factions behind this abnormality. We may still have an opportunity to uncover clues and proceed with our investigation.”
target: “Primum nuntios de casu Moran Avigny opprimamus, ne eos et factiones quae hanc abnormitatem regunt excitare possimus. Fortasse adhuc habebimus occasionem vestigia detegendi atque inquisitionem prosequendi.”

source: This was his experience and a process the Purifiers were already familiar with.
target: Hoc erat eius experientia et processus quem Purificatores iam cognovissent.
